title: feat(console): the first-run checklist takes a host profile; a managed environment adds first-app and first-record rows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9W1gLJVaYxfVqKEHUqbYPfn)_

Fixes #34251

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：环境首页「准备好你的系统」清单改为按宿主配置（profile）画行。云端托管环境（`features.cloudManaged: true`）多出「放进第一个应用」「添加第一条记录」两行，邮件行在读到已投递前不画；自托管环境与今天完全一样。
- 为什么改：托管客户现在同时看到云端首页和环境首页两套入门清单；按 cloud#4465 的裁决，人员、应用、记录都在环境里，环境清单要成为唯一入门路径（cloud#4304 等它收掉云端清单）。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台，不改服务端、不加新字段；自托管路径有测试钉住「行不变」。回滚即整体 revert 本 PR。已知限制：「第一条记录」读活动流，活动流只保留 14 天，所以该行在托管 profile 里是可选行，不会让清单重新出现。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/firstRunChecklistProfile.ts`（profile 表与两行读数）、`FirstRunChecklist.tsx` 中按 `profile.addedRows` 画行与 `profileDrawsRow` 过滤那段、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/platformApp.ts`（内置应用判据，原住 AiChatPage）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`，预期新 describe「the host profile…」9 条全绿，其余原有用例不变。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The console's first-run checklist (`FirstRunChecklist.tsx`) now draws its rows from a **profile**, a declarative table in the new `firstRunChecklistProfile.ts`. The served flag `features.cloudManaged` of `GET /api/v1/auth/config` selects the profile. The flag is already served by plugin-auth, and the auth client already holds its answer from sign-in, so this sends no new request and serves no new field. The component reads the profile's lists (`addedRows`, `hiddenUntilDone`, `optionalRows`) and has no branch on the host.

| Profile | Selected when | Changes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `SELF_HOSTED_PROFILE` | flag off, absent, or config unreadable | none: today's rows |
| `MANAGED_PROFILE` | `cloudManaged === true` | adds `first_app`, `first_record` (optional); `mail` hidden until it reads done |

The two "done" reads, with their request cost:

- **Put your first app in** (`hasOwnApp`): the launcher lists an app that is not a platform built-in. It reads `useLauncherApps`, the console's existing `/me/apps` answer, so it costs **0 requests**. The card's literal reading ("`/me/apps` non-empty") is true on every environment, because an administrator's list always carries Setup and Studio (`com.objectstack.*`, `requiredPermissions: ['setup.access']`). The built-in test is app-shell's `isPlatformBuiltinApp`, moved from `AiChatPage.tsx` to `utils/platformApp.ts` and exported from the package root, so the AI switcher and the checklist share one criterion (seat ruling). `AiChatPage` re-exports it for its existing importers.
- **Add your first record** (`readFirstRecordCreated`): **1 request**, `find('sys_activity', { $filter: { type: 'created', actor_id: { $ne: null }, object_name: { $in: OBJECTS } }, $top: 1 })`. `OBJECTS` is the set of objects that the environment's own apps list in their navigation, so platform objects are out by construction. `type` and `actor_id` are indexed. When no own app lists an object, the answer is "no" and no request is sent. A failed or refused read leaves the row out; it is never shown as not done. ⚠️ `sys_activity` keeps 14 days (`lifecycle.retention`), so the managed profile makes this row optional, per the seat's ruling: it never holds the checklist open and is not counted in progress.
- **Email delivery** on the managed profile is drawn only once `isMailDelivering` (the `live.provider` statement of `GET /api/settings/mail`) reads delivering. The hosted platform channel is a transport that statement cannot name (#32799, still open), so without this the row would read "not set up" on an environment whose mail is delivered.

`checklistCompletion` takes an optional-row predicate. Its default is unchanged, and the component passes the profile's answer. `ChecklistRow` takes `optional` as a prop instead of reading `OPTIONAL_ROWS` itself. The i18n keys `console.firstRunChecklist.firstApp.*` and `firstRecord.*` are added to all eleven packs, one line per row.

## Tests

- `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx` gains a top-level `describe('the host profile: …')` with 9 pins:
  - self-hosted draws exactly today's six rows, with no activity read;
  - an unreadable config is self-hosted;
  - managed, with an own app and a created row, ticks both rows and sends exactly one `sys_activity` read with the filter above;
  - **CONTROL:** an empty activity answer leaves the record row not done;
  - **CONTROL:** a launcher holding only built-ins leaves the app row not done and sends no activity read;
  - managed shows the row order, the record row as optional, the app row as required, mail absent, and `0 of 6 done`;
  - **CONTROL:** delivering mail is drawn, done;
  - managed with every required row done and no record draws nothing;
  - zh wording.
- The new `firstRunChecklistProfile.test.ts` holds the pure pins: profile selection (including `cloudManaged: 'true'`), the lists, completion with the predicate (with CONTROL), `hasOwnApp`, `appObjectNames`, and the read (no request on empty, the query, rejection on failure).
- The AiChatPage predicate tests (`deriveBoundPackageId.test.ts`) still pass unchanged through the re-export.

|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `ownApps` keeps built-ins | 5 failed (both app-row CONTROLs among them) |

The first A5 attempt was an anchor miss: the shell expanded the dollar sign, and the tool refused before running anything. It was re-run from a script file, and the mutation landed.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "done when `GET /api/v1/me/apps` is non-empty" is refined to "lists an app that is not a platform built-in", because the literal reading is always true for an administrator. The seat agreed.
- "A person created a record" is read from the 14-day activity feed. This was the seat's choice (option A). The audit log was not used because it needs the audit read permission. A per-object count would be unbounded in requests.
- The mail row's hiding goes away by itself once the platform channel reads delivering (`live.provider`), which is #32799's remaining half. That half is on its card.
- If the cloud adds hosted apps outside `com.objectstack.*`, they would count as "your first app". None is known today. Noted, not filed.

## Verification

Local gate subset, derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the final head and reconciled with `--ran`: see the os-dev-report on #34251. CI runs every other family.
